ctaHeading: Ready to Restore Your Cheltenham Roof?
aboutText: Royce Roofing has been delivering expert roofing solutions across Cheltenham and Melbourne's southeast for years. Led by Luke and supported by a skilled team including estimator Adam, we specialise in roof restorations, rebedding, repointing, and a comprehensive range of roofing services. Our commitment to quality workmanship, transparent quoting, and thorough site cleanups has earned the trust of homeowners and businesses throughout the Cheltenham area. From initial inspection to final finish, we treat every roof as if it were our own.
servicesText: From full roof restorations to emergency repairs, Royce Roofing provides a complete range of roofing services for Cheltenham homes and businesses. Whether you need ridge capping rebedded, Colorbond installed, or a thorough roof inspection, our experienced team delivers quality results every time.

services.title: Roof Restorations
services.desc: Complete roof restoration services including cleaning, painting, and sealing to bring your tired roof back to life.

services.title: Ridge Capping Rebedding
services.desc: Expert rebedding and repointing of ridge capping to secure loose tiles and prevent water ingress.

services.title: Roof Repairs
services.desc: Prompt and reliable roof repair services for leaks, damaged tiles, and storm damage across Cheltenham.

services.title: Colorbond Roofing
services.desc: Supply and installation of premium Colorbond roofing and metal sheeting, ideal for modern Australian homes in any climate.

services.title: Gutter & Fascia
services.desc: New gutter, downpipe, and fascia installation to keep your roof drainage system performing at its best.

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.desc: Thorough roof inspections and detailed reports for buyers, sellers, and property managers throughout Melbourne's southeast.

testimonialsSubheading: Trusted by homeowners across Melbourne's southeast

reviews.text: Luke's team from Royce did a fantastic job rebedding and repointing our ridge capping in Cheltenham. Adam provided a detailed quote after a thorough inspection and walked us through every option. The work was completed quickly, professionally, and they cleaned up everything when done.
reviews.name: Mark T.

reviews.text: We had Royce Roofing restore our entire roof after years of wear and tear. The team was punctual, professional, and the finished result looked brand new. Great communication from start to finish and very fair pricing for the quality of work delivered.
reviews.name: Sarah L.

reviews.text: As a property manager, I need reliable tradespeople I can count on. Royce Roofing has handled multiple roof repairs and restorations across our portfolio in the southeast. Luke and his team always deliver on time and on budget, with no callbacks needed.
reviews.name: David K.
